parents.subject: efalnd: Fix double free of QP on device init failure

commit.subject: efalnd: Return correct error code on CQ create failure
commit.message:
efalnd: Return correct error code on CQ create failure

The completion queue create error path returns the is-error predicate
instead of the actual negative error code.

Return the extracted error code.

Fixes: 0c773016d837 ("LU-18977 efalnd: Introduce AWS EFA Lustre network driver")
Change-Id: Iea89f0000f8ba98f07dcc40ed9979aef8556b838
Signed-off-by: Tom Sela <tomsela@amazon.com>
